setup.description: Configure round settings and teams, then start the tournament. Round 1 pairings are randomized.
setup.totalRoundsHint: Number of rounds for this tournament (1–10). Defaults to your settings value.
setup.roundSettingsLockedHint: Some settings cannot be changed while the tournament is ongoing.
settings.defaultTournamentNameHint: This name is pre-filled when a new tournament is created.
settings.roundDurationHint: Set how long each round should last. The timer will count down from this value.
settings.totalRoundsHint: Set how many rounds the tournament will have by default (1–10).
settings.roundDurationError: Must be a whole number between 1 and 120.
settings.totalRoundsError: Must be a whole number between 1 and 10.
settings.exclusionPickerStaticHint: Only relevant when the number of teams is odd. Determines which team does not play that round.
settings.exclusionScorerStaticHint: Only relevant when the number of teams is odd. Determines how the score is calculated for the team that sits out.
exclusionPicker.middle.description: The team ranked in the middle of the current standings sits out. If that team has already sat out before, the next eligible team downward is chosen instead.
exclusionScorer.meanOf3.description: The excluded team receives the average of the best, worst, and two middle scores of the playing teams, rounded up.
exclusionScorer.bestScore.description: The excluded team receives the same score as the best-performing team that played this round.
